body: Landing/install condition for TermAl w-18a1 (Fable2 #5577, 2026-11-11): its R9+ sends the Engram source command --timeout-ms 60000, but the installed Engram source owner caps at 30000; 60000 arrives only with Engram w-6ecc in the Engram sync install. On EACH host (Central and DL560) the Engram sync install must come FIRST, then the TermAl w-18a1 install; otherwise every committed-input evaluation on that host is refused NotClean. Check this at w-18a1 install time on both hosts.
